text: {"justification": "The gas meter and regulator sit on the same wall right next to the electric meter, so any install spot must stay 5 ft away from them. json.justification: The gas meter and regulator sit on the same wall right next to the electric meter, so any install spot must stay 5 ft away from them. Farther along that wall, the AC condenser and its electrical disconnect crowd the run. Around the corner, the wall has windows and gravel/mulch ground, so a compliant install spot with a clear wiring run cannot be confidently confirmed.
